komudī.cp: fem. moonlight; the full-moon day in the month kattika.
komudī.p: [Kumuda+ṇa+ī] (thī) CL=7 (1) Moonlight (Ti) (2) Blooming the lotuses. Still blooming the lotuses (under the moonlight).
pn:
Komudī. The full-moon day of the fourth month of the Rainy Season, Kattika, usually found in the phrase Komudī Catumāsinī.

The Commentary (DN-a.i.139) says it was so-called because then the white water-lily flowered luxuriantly (kumudāni supupphitāni honti). Vin.i.155, 176f; DN.i.47; MN.iii.79, 80; Dhp-a.iii.461; Ja.v.262, etc.
